blocks.text: KIDAPAWAN CITY, Cotabato—At least four students were injured in a shooting incident inside the Banga National High School in Banga town, South Cotabato. A video carried on social media around 2 p.m. Friday by Bombo Radyo–Koronadal showed students being hauled for medical treatment.
